---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for RealityCheck
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ['enhancement']
assignees: ''
---

## 🚀 Feature Description
**A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see**

## 💡 Problem or Need
**What problem does this feature solve? What use case does it address?**

## 🎯 Proposed Solution
**Describe your preferred solution. How should this feature work?**

## 🔧 Implementation Ideas (Optional)
**Any thoughts on how this could be implemented technically?**

## 📊 Data Requirements (if applicable)
- **New KPI needed**: [Yes/No]
- **Data source**: [e.g. World Bank, OWID, custom dataset]
- **Update frequency**: [e.g. annual, monthly]
- **Countries covered**: [e.g. all 190+, specific regions]

## 🎨 UI/UX Considerations
**How should this feature be presented to users?**
- [ ] New page
- [ ] Addition to existing page
- [ ] New visualization type
- [ ] Settings/configuration option

## 📱 Platform Support
**Which platforms should this feature support?**
- [ ] Desktop web browsers
- [ ] Mobile web browsers
- [ ] Tablet devices
- [ ] All platforms

## 🖼️ Mockups or Examples
**Include sketches, mockups, or examples from other sites (optional)**

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions
**Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered**

## 📋 Acceptance Criteria
**How will we know this feature is complete and working correctly?**
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## 🏷️ Priority
- [ ] Critical (essential for core functionality)
- [ ] High (important for user experience)
- [ ] Medium (nice to have enhancement)
- [ ] Low (future consideration)

## 📊 Impact Assessment
**Who would benefit from this feature?**
- [ ] All users
- [ ] Data analysts/researchers
- [ ] Casual browsers
- [ ] Education users
- [ ] Mobile users

## 🔗 Related Issues
**Link to any related issues or discussions**
